proposition: Late Timurid biographers remembered Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī and Ibn Turka as fellow disciples of Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī in Cairo: Gāzurgāhī (909/1503-4) has both of them spending years in spiritual exercises in the ground-floor apartment of Akhlāṭī's house.

mediation.who: Kamāl al-Dīn Ḥusayn Gāzurgāhī, Majālis al-ʿUshshāq
mediation.note: a tazkira written some decades after the men's deaths; MK says its death date for Akhlāṭī is wrong
